title: Workspace owner canonical brand create lifecycle

phases.objective: Allow an authenticated workspace owner/admin to create or idempotently reuse a canonical brand identity and atomically establish explicit tenant authority, a Brand Workspace, and a creator admin grant, while governing the endpoint as a tested transactional state change.

e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: Owner authority is revalidated under lock in the mutation transaction; canonical brand, tenant link, Brand Workspace, and creator admin grant converge with exact readbacks; and generated operation governance classifies the endpoint as a tested state change instead of an unresolved mutation candidate.
steps: Normalize the requested display name and derive deterministic tenant-scoped creation identity.
Revalidate exactly one active owner/admin membership with a locking read inside the transaction.
Reuse or create exactly one active canonical brands row.
Create or repair an active tenant_brand_links row with workspace_owner_brand_create provenance.
Create or reuse a deterministic workspace_registry Brand Workspace bound by linked_brand_key and keep bootstrap_status in_progress until Brand Core prerequisites exist.
Create or repair the creator's explicit brand/admin workspace grant.
Read back tenant link, Brand Workspace, and creator grant before commit and roll back on mutation or readback failure.
Register exact frontend operation evidence for POST /me/workspaces/{tenant_id}/brands.

Generate the Brand Create state_change rule only when route, runtime auth, transaction, locked owner authority, canonical identity, tenant link, Brand Workspace, creator grant, no-secret response, and registered operation test evidence all pass.
Run the governance-generator regression that proves Brand Create is emitted only when evidence is complete and is rejected when owner/test evidence disappears.
Require generated operation governance, frontend dispatch, and runtime route evidence to match the final source tree.
assertions: A non-owner/admin or missing/inactive membership fails closed before brand lifecycle mutation.
Equivalent brand names within one tenant are idempotent while same display name creation in another tenant does not collide.
Brand Workspace identity is deterministic, workspace_type=brand, and linked_brand_key equals canonical brand target_key.
Brand Workspace ambiguity/collision fails closed before creator-grant mutation.
The creator alone receives the explicit brand admin grant; creation does not grant all workspace members access.
tenant_brand_links uses workspace_owner_brand_create authority provenance rather than historical projection provenance.
workspace_resource_grants uses existing owner_assignment source and bounded workspace_brand_create metadata.
The operation-governance generator fails closed when required Brand Create evidence is missing.

With complete evidence, Brand Create is classified state_change with runtime authorization, transactional readback before commit, transaction rollback, parameter bindings, and registered test evidence.
Generated frontend dispatch contains no operation_classification_gap for Brand Create.
No Migration Apply, live SQL mutation, Production/provider mutation, deployment, credential/secret access, force push, or external send occurs in CI.
